entities.name: Armenian Apostolic Church
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Armenian Apostolic Church, a political institution in Armenia during Arsacid Armenia and Christianization (301–330). Grew from Gregory the Illuminator consecrated as first Catholicos of Armenia and Armenia adopts Christianity as state religion under Tiridates III. Led to the emergence of Tiridates III and Invention of the Armenian Alphabet.
